artifacts.source: Authenticated frankel CP3A.261005.005 boot.img contains this exact legacy-LZ4 4K kernel payload. Header/banner/config recovered statically; no kernel execution or module KMI qualification. See native-boot-inputs/evidence/factory-metadata.json.

Authenticated system_dlkm/vendor_dlkm and vendor-kernel ramdisk inventories are recovered. Complete deployed module dependency, signature/protected-symbol and KMI/load closure remains unqualified; the 16K fragment is separate.
Original vendor inventory contains GPU/AoC/radio/Wi-Fi/BT/calibration inputs. Complete device firmware/calibration inventory and initialization are unresolved.
artifacts/runtime/runtime-manifest.json: /vendor/firmware/rgx.fw.signed.71.2.2448.1212; recorded file hash only, not matched kernel/driver or GPU execution proof.

gates.evidence: Whole official frankel CP3A.261005.005 ZIP matches published SHA256 3721e6accc2e87d851ee7966d794318078ec74c7cc32343daa10968264d6bb62; 38 index reads rebound to authenticated stream and 14 selected members hash checked on 2026-10-13. AVB verification remains unresolved. See native-boot-inputs/evidence/factory-metadata.json.

Authenticated 4K kernel payload/banner/config and separate 16K kernel are recovered. Retain exact Google matched inputs; vendor module vermagic strings differ from base GKI release. MODVERSIONS and MODULE_SIG_PROTECT are enabled; strings alone establish neither compatibility nor incompatibility. Actual dependency/symbol-CRC/protected-signature/module-load closure remains unresolved.

Factory camera/audio/power/sensors/radio userspace dependencies are not a completed native replacement. Shannon APK remains original comparison infrastructure. Native IMS/calls/modem ACK and recovery semantics are unresolved.
Factory Bionic libraries, Android properties, Binder, APEX and dynamic dependency closure are not qualified for native glibc services. ELF interpreter checks do not prove transitive ABI closure.

Authored Rust root PID1, native child actual wait and controlled RAM-only shutdown pass on non-Pixel Arch ARM7.1.6. Pixel native ramdisk packaging, diagnostic transport and Arch service supervision/order/restart integration remain offline work; no phone boot or privileged host service mutation.
Matched Pixel policy/service contexts/device-node labels and native-domain enforcement remain offline integration work. Enforcing synthetic Binder fixtures do not prove installed Pixel policy.

Standard Pixel Binder service discovery, current interface/hash checks, backend process death/reset identities and node availability are unresolved; synthetic fixture discovery is not a production binding.
Installed per-service Linux principals, authenticated authorization, device-node access and lock/revoke ingress must be closed independently of manifest declarations.

Declared single owners/dependency order are desired deployment constraints, not proof of running native services. Radio/IMS/calls/camera/audio/connectivity/sensors/notifications/contact/media and background state still need installed integration.
No phone accessed. Later authorized device boot, carrier, GPU/display, input, camera/DMA, audio/AoC, sensors, charging/thermal and suspend/wake qualification remain physical gates.

capabilities.detail: Native vendor registration/request ownership and bounded IMS reader components exist; production call/IMS/carrier/media semantics and installed Phone service are unresolved.
Native codecs, durable outbox/receipt/inbox and synthetic frozen-V3 transport exist; production receive identity/ACK reset, delivery and modem qualification remain unresolved.
Frozen AIDL4 ownership/error/FD fixtures exist; buffer/DMA/fence/publication/storage, exact factory interface hash and capture remain unresolved.
Native arbiter/suspend coordinator components exist; installed authority, vendor wake accounting, Pixel nodes/thermal/charging remain unresolved.
Original PipeWire virtual graph ownership is tested; Pixel AoC/DSP/carrier routing, PCM brokerage and installed streams remain unresolved.
Read-only isolated NetworkManager boundary is tested; mutation, BlueZ, Pixel Wi-Fi/BT/coexistence/USB/tethering remain unresolved.
Original FMQ/EventFlag/frozen-suspend fixtures exist; source wake obligations, calibration, GNSS/haptics and installed delivery remain unresolved.
ARM VM Omarchy/Hyprland work is separate; Pixel PowerVR/DRM scanout, allocator/fences/input/display ownership and boot remain unresolved.
Native lifecycle/storage components and current Messages work do not establish complete phone background notification or Pixel suspend/wake behavior.
Carrier dependencies and native implementation are unqualified.
Provisioning and native carrier/device integration are unqualified.
Retaining a provider does not establish Pixel Camera app feature/image-quality parity.
